items.title: Lou Marini interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 15, 2023
items.q: And James will, at this point he’ll say you know I think this tune is horn-worthy, and the rhythm section will start rehearsing it and Walt and I will — I’ll play something, Walt will play something, we’re like, “Let’s remember that.”

ctx.x: Who writes the horn parts for these?

Walt and I do. And you know that’s been another thing because it’s so naturally organic. I’ll play something and Walt will go — because James will — at first there were no horn parts. So now we’re up to in the 90s. And James will, at this point he’ll say you know I think this tune is horn-worthy, and the rhythm section will start rehearsing it and Walt and I will — I’ll play something, Walt will play something, we’re like, “Let’s remember that.” And then we go into a hotel room or a room in the venue and sit down…
You must be cognizant of course of when he is singing and regarding the horn parts.
